comment: Budgets in bytes. Raise deliberately, never to make CI pass. 2026-11-17: shipped 511.7 -> 517.0 KB and mobile 149.5 -> 152.0 KB for the motion system (S24-05: two keyframes and the overlay classes in theme.css) and the platform gates (S24-04); measured growth was 0.7 KB shipped and 0.8 KB mobile, the rest is headroom. Same day: initial 210.9 -> 213.5 KB and shipped 515.0 -> 517.0 KB for the alert-rule editor (S24-11: the rules list, its three selects and two numeric fields, plus the connectivity card in the diagnosis dialog); measured growth 1.6 KB initial and 2.4 KB shipped. Same day again: shipped 517.0 -> 520.0 KB and initial 213.5 -> 214.5 KB for the notification-channel editor (S24-11: a destination list with a kind and a severity select, name, URL and secret fields, and the test button); measured growth 0.9 KB shipped and 0.6 KB initial. 2026-11-19: initial 214.5 -> 215.0 KB, shipped 520.0 -> 522.0 KB and installer 5,746.5 -> 5,808.0 KB for the MQTT settings screen and the capability gating (S24-13, S24-04) in the webview, and for the MCP server plus the absence ripple in the binary - the desktop links vitals-server, so the new read-only MCP route is installed with the app. Measured growth: 0.2 KB initial, 0.6 KB shipped, 59.1 KB installer; the installer figure is the honest price of shipping the MCP route inside the app rather than as a separate binary. 2026-11-19: initial 215.0 -> 216.0 KB and shipped 522.0 -> 523.0 KB for the Task Manager move warning copy (moving a per-machine copy to per-user turns the Task Manager replacement off, and the Settings pane now says so); measured 215.3 KB initial and 522.0 KB shipped, so both were raised to the next whole KiB rather than by the script's 5 percent, which would have cost 11 KB of headroom for a 0.3 KB change. 2026-11-24: shipped 523.0 -> 532.0 KB only, for the AI page's Resources tab with its per-client usage rows (S26-03) and the always-present End task button on the Processes toolbar (S26-02); measured 530.4 KB and raised to a whole KiB, again not by the script's 5 percent, which would have cost 25 KB of headroom. initial (215.6), hud (122.0) and mobile (150.8) were all under budget and were left alone. Never run scripts/check-size.ps1 -Update to adjust one number: it rewrites this history into a single generic sentence and writes a placeholder installerBytes whenever no installer has been built.2026-11-24, later the same day: installer 5,812.0 -> 5,872.0 KB for the AI agents page. The measured installer went from 5,708.0 KB (the published 1.3.0 asset, 5,844,958 bytes, read from the release through the API) to 5,864.1 KB (6,004,807 bytes), and that 156 KB is not the webview alone: the shipped bundle rose 9.4 KB gzip, and the rest is the MQTT settings screen, the read-only MCP route inside the binary and the Task Manager move warning, all of which were built after 1.3.0 was tagged and only now sit in an installer. Raised to the next whole 8 KiB rather than by the script's 5 percent, which would have cost 300 KB of headroom for a 52 KB overrun. The four webview budgets needed nothing: 215.7 / 531.4 / 122.1 / 150.9 KB measured, each under its own.
